description: This file implements PHP4 session management using the ADODB database wrapper library. It provides functions for opening, reading, writing, destroying, and garbage collecting database-backed sessions, with configuration setup and example usage included.

methods.name: adodb_session_regenerate_id
methods.description: Regenerates the session ID, updates the session record in the database, and manages session cookies accordingly.

methods.name: adodb_sess_open
methods.description: Initializes a database connection for session management, optionally persistent.

methods.name: adodb_sess_close
methods.description: Closes the database connection used for session management.

methods.name: adodb_sess_read
methods.description: Reads session data from the database for the given session key.

methods.name: adodb_sess_write
methods.description: Writes session data to the database, updating existing records if unchanged or inserting new ones.

methods.name: adodb_sess_destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data from the database for the specified session key, optionally triggering expiration notifications.

methods.name: adodb_sess_gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection on expired sessions, with optional database optimization and notification handling.
